searchText: https://youtu.be/TVG4Xb-YDiY <@543900561460822016> why don't you recommend the abstract section for ERCs? Imo since ERCs usually define an interface from scratch, it’s difficult to convey in the abstract without just specifying it. Seems like simple summary suffices in most cases I suppose it depends on how complicated the ERC is, and whether it has an overarching concept that would be valuable to express. That’s true I agree that I have seen some where the abstract doesn't help. I have also seen some where the abstract was a useful overview. (I haven't actually read the one you recently commented on, so I don't know which camp it is in)
